name: swipe-actions
summary: A list row whose actions a swipe reveals; the same actions are always one press away in a menu, so a swipe is never the only way.

properties.name: label
properties.description: What the row is, such as a message's subject. It names the row and the actions button.

properties.name: actionsLabel
properties.description: The name of the button that opens the actions menu. Default "Actions for {label}".

properties.name: leading
properties.description: The actions a swipe toward the end reveals, by label; the first is the primary one.

properties.name: trailing
properties.description: The actions a swipe toward the start reveals, by label; the first is the primary one.

properties.name: tone
properties.description: The colour behind each side's first action, the one a long swipe commits, such as destructive for Delete. The other actions are secondary.

slots.name: content
slots.description: The row the person sees at rest, usually an Item.

events.name: menu
events.description: The actions menu opened, from the actions button or by a long press on the row. It holds the same actions as the swipe.

events.name: action
events.description: An action was chosen, by a swipe past 60% of the row's width on its primary action, by a press on a revealed action, or from the menu.

states.name: rest
states.description: The row alone. Its actions button shows at the end for a pointer and is hidden from sight on a touch screen, where a long press opens the menu; assistive technology reaches it on any device.

states.name: pressed
states.description: Swiped part way: the actions of that side show behind the row, which stays where the finger left it.

states.name: focused
states.description: The menu button with keyboard focus: the platform's focus ring.

accessibility.name: The row is named by its label; the menu button "Actions for {label}".
accessibility.keyboard: The menu button is a tab stop; Enter or Space opens the menu, the arrow keys move through its actions, Enter chooses one and Escape closes it. A chosen action that removes the row moves focus to the next row (the one before, when it was last).
accessibility.web: The row's content plus a menu button; the swipe is a pointer gesture and is hidden from assistive technology.
accessibility.apple: Row content with accessibility custom actions for each action, plus the menu.
accessibility.windows: UI Automation ControlType.Group named by its label, with a ControlType.Button ("Actions for {label}") that opens a MenuFlyout; the swipe is a touch gesture only.
accessibility.android: One merged node named by its label with a custom accessibility action per action, plus a menu button; the swipe is a touch gesture only.

cases.person: A row of text; a pointer also sees a small more button at its end. Swiped left, a red Delete and an Archive show behind it.
The same row, with a Pin action to its start.

deviations: Web takes the actions as arrays of { label, onClick, tone }; the spec lists them by label, each platform's host supplies the handlers, and one tone colours each side's first action while the rest are secondary.

windows.type: Ouro.UI.Windows.OuroSwipeActions, a templated WinUI Control; not yet built

android.type: bot.ouro.ui.hx.OuroSwipeActions, in Jetpack Compose (ourostack/ouro-ui-android); not yet built
